query: INSERT INTO device_battery_latest (device_id, name, kind, battery_voltage, battery_percent, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, now()) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, battery_voltage = EXCLUDED.battery_voltage, battery_percent = EXCLUDED.battery_percent, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
